note: Proposed evaluator configurations for OWNER DECISION. Nothing here is a registration: the production registry cases/evaluators.json stays empty until the owner approves an identity, its prompt and the artifacts it may read. Registering one of these is decision D1; sending cited private source to a remote endpoint is decision D2.
registration_requires: an owner-approved identity (exact model + version + served identity, or a named human)
the packet instructions and their sha256, which every evaluation records
the endpoint and the exact data that leaves the machine
a fingerprint recorded next to trusted=true in cases/evaluators.json

included: the frozen question text and its sha256
the frozen answer artifact (answer text, claims, citations, declared gaps)
the frozen pack: paths, ranges, hashes, verification state and content when present
the exact text of the spans the answer itself cited, resolved from the frozen corpus
the public C1-C6 rubric and REPORT-CONTRACT.md
never_included: gold spans or the scope manifest
the per-case C3 checklist (only its sha256 is used as a binding digest)
the answerer's session, transcript or read ledger
any grader verdict, previous evaluation or baseline numbers
the corpus outside cited spans and pack items
packet_policy.authority: the evaluator identity and the five input digests are injected from the packet by r4_semantic_evaluator.py accept; a model response that tries to set them is rejected

candidates.served_identity: record the server name, weights digest and quantization at run time
candidates.data_flow: no data leaves the machine; full cited source stays local
candidates.privacy: compatible with private HRM2.0 source without D2
candidates.notes: cost is electricity/time only; the evaluator's independence rests on a different model family and a separate process, and must be stated at registration
candidates.evidence_required_before_registration: a smoke run over the crafted fixtures in r4_semantic_e2e.py with the exact prompt, plus a served-identity capture

candidates.served_identity: the provider's returned model/snapshot string, recorded per evaluation
candidates.data_flow: question + answer + pack metadata + cited span text leave the machine to the provider; no other source, no gold, no checklist
candidates.privacy: REQUIRES owner decision D2: the cited spans are private HRM2.0 source. Until D2 the endpoint must not be called with real case artefacts.
candidates.notes: rates are an illustrative list-price example, not a quote; replace with the provider's current price sheet before committing a budget
candidates.evidence_required_before_registration: sanitized-fixture smoke run, served-identity capture, and a written D2 approval naming the endpoint and data classes

candidates.served_identity: named reviewer with no access to the answerer session or gold spans
candidates.notes: the strongest independence claim available today; cost is reviewer time per evaluation
candidates.evidence_required_before_registration: the reviewer's name, instructions version and a signed statement that gold spans and the answerer session were not read
